summary: Certified bug fix: QuotesTable now displays LINK_PAGO quote-type variant labels correctly in /quotes list. Each LINK_PAGO quote row shows the specific variant (Link de Pago / Tokenizador / Link/Tokenizador) instead of the previous generic 'Link de Pago' for all. Regression verified: other quote types (VPOS, MPOS Imple+POS, Payment Gateway, Verifone/Equipos, Accesorio, Reparación) render unchanged, and the category filter 'Implementación Link de Pago' still returns all 8 LINK_PAGO quotes (grouping/filter key unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: QuotesTable.jsx L36-42 getQuoteTypeName(type, variant) — implementation is compact and defensive (uppercases type, lowercases variant, falls back to legacy mapping). Fix is minimal and correct.

displayType (L277) branches for repair/fast_track/equipment first, then defers to getQuoteTypeName(quote_type, link_pago_variant). Correct ordering — LINK_PAGO can never collide with repair/fast_track/equipment.
File is 725 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider extracting the action-overrides helpers and the massive DropdownMenu block into subcomponents in a future refactor. Not blocking.

Observed distribution across 105 quote rows: Link de Pago=2 (COT-063, COT-056), Tokenizador=3 (COT-064, COT-062, COT-060), Link/Tokenizador=3 (COT-061, COT-059, COT-058), Payment Gateway=1, VPOS=8, MPOS (Imple + POS)=1, Verifone=44, Reparación=36, Equipos=1, Accesorio=6. rca of the issue: Bug: QuotesTable.getQuoteTypeName only took quote_type and mapped LINK_PAGO→'Link de Pago' generically, ignoring quote.link_pago_variant. All LINK_PAGO rows displayed identically regardless of variant (link_pago/tokenizador/ambos). Fix applied by main agent: added LINK_VARIANT_LABELS map and extended getQuoteTypeName to receive variant; displayType now passes quote.link_pago_variant. Verified visually and via DOM extraction that every LINK_PAGO row now reflects its true variant.
